claims: NASA's Artemis II mission successfully lifted off on April 1, 2026.
NASA's Artemis II mission lifted off at 6:35 p.m. EDT (2235 UTC).
NASA's Artemis II mission lifted off from Launch Pad 39B at the Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
Artemis II has a four-person crew.
Artemis II marks the first crewed lunar flight since 1972.
Live coverage of the Artemis II mission was provided by NASA and major news outlets.
Artemis II is a crewed circumlunar mission.
The crew of Artemis II is Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, Jeremy Hansen
